source: Enter the URL or document name of your fabricator's current capability page
notes: Generic template. Every limit is absent on purpose: enter your fabricator's current published values, set profileDate to the day you read them and keep status UNVERIFIED until you have checked them yourself. Hole, annular-ring, clearance and trace limits go in scopedLimits, one entry per published limit with its own hole type, layer count, copper weight, layer side, ledger row, quote and retrievedOn; a limit your fabricator does not publish for a scope is entered with published false and no value, or left out.
